name: Before recital 1 – 91
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: (-1) Environmental assessments these days are often inadequate, or even non-existent for some projects, and lead to legal challenges that result in the projects being cancelled. Work on cancelled projects has sometimes already begun, causing irreversible damage to ecosystems. Environmental assessments must therefore be strengthened, not weakened, in order to prevent biodiversity destruction caused by projects that are ultimately cancelled by the courts.
